label_derivations.F00009: Public signature main(*, doctor_checks=None), with optional Sequence[DiagnosticCheck], forwards invocation additions through _handle_doctor to run_doctor; None and empty additions preserve defaults. label_derivations.F00010: Constructor value validation remains exactly identity True/False/None and True implies error_code/remediation None; no broader message/name/code validation. label_derivations.F00026: CheckResult.passed is bool | None, the sole admitted verdict input in ordinary construction: identity True = measured pass, False = measured failure, None = could-not-verify. An independently supplied status keyword is an illegal ordinary constructor input and must be refused with TypeError through the declared main-driven conformance observation.
